body.text: Sir. I have no gift for this sort of letter and I will not pretend to one.

Men of mine have walked the country inland of {param:town} and come back saying your people are further west each season, and better fed than mine. I do not blame you for that. I am obliged to do something about it.
{param:amount} in coin would answer for this year. Understand that I am not selling you anything: there is nothing you could buy from me and nothing I will offer.
If you refuse I shall think no worse of you personally, which I mention because you will hear it said that I am a reasonable man, and it is true, and it will make no difference at all.

tone.text: To the Warden of the Northern Reach — I write {choice}.

options.label: pay him
options.text: The sum will be sent from my Treasury. I trust your season improves.

options.label: refuse him
options.text: You will have nothing from me, this season or any other.
